articles.title: Flamethrowers, Boycotts, and a Floating Piano: Inside Eurovision’s Chaotic 70th Final
articles.summary: Eurovision’s 70th anniversary final in Vienna mixed glitter with grit: a Finnish violinist played with fire, five nations boycotted over Israel’s inclusion, and protesters chanted outside. Australia’s Delta Goodrem soared above a piano, while a Moldovan rapper snuck in a pro-Europe message.

articles.title: Shakira and Burna Boy’s ‘Dai Dai’ Aims to Be the Next ‘Waka Waka’—and Raise $100 Million
articles.summary: Shakira’s fourth World Cup anthem, “Dai Dai,” features Nigerian Afrobeats giant Burna Boy and blends Latin pop with a global rallying cry. Royalties will fund kids’ education through FIFA’s $100 million goal, while the duo headlines the first-ever World Cup final halftime show.

articles.title: When a Beatle Hijacks Your Monologue: Paul McCartney’s Surprise SNL Cameo with Will Ferrell
articles.summary: Will Ferrell’s SNL hosting gig turned into a doppelgänger comedy when Chad Smith impersonated him—then Paul McCartney crashed the monologue, insisting Ferrell was the drummer. The legendary Beatle stole the bit, reminding everyone of his songwriting catalog before ordering Ferrell to the drums.
